# See common/landed_titles/zz_vanilla_titulars.txt for what they are and why.

on_title_gain = {
	on_actions = {
		gen_strip_vanilla_titular
	}
}

on_title_gain_inheritance = {
	on_actions = {
		gen_strip_vanilla_titular
	}
}

on_title_gain_usurpation = {
	on_actions = {
		gen_strip_vanilla_titular
	}
}

on_game_start = {
	on_actions = {
		gen_mark_vanilla_titulars
	}
}

# root = the new holder, scope:title = the title that changed hands.
gen_strip_vanilla_titular = {
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:title = { has_variable = gen_vanilla_titular }
			}
			destroy_title = scope:title
		}
	}
}
